img150.png.text: The framework captures the reduced-order dynamics with a linear ODE in a complex-valued latent space. An autoencoder (or variational autoencoder) maps the high-dimensional state to the latent variables. The eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the linear system matrix decouple the latent variables into independent processes. Each process has its own time scale: the real part of its eigenvalue gives the growth or decay rate, and the imaginary part gives the oscillation. A probabilistic state-space formulation, which can be trained on irregularly sampled data, adds predictive uncertainty. The dynamics can be propagated in the latent space and then decoded back to the full state.
